title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
summary: OpenAI 向10万名学术研究人员免费提供ChatGPT最先进的AI模型，以加速科学研究、协作和发现。
highlights: OpenAI is giving 100,000 academic researchers free access to ChatGPT's most advanced AI models
to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery
